intro: Every word this module's exercises use, on one deck of flashcards: 257 cards, 142 of them nouns. The vocabulary of this module is academic and formal register: nominal style, research vocabulary and fixed noun-verb pairs, from the themes Bildung & Wissenschaft, Forschung & Technik, Sprache & Denken, Arbeitswelt akademisch. Write the German, choose it from four options, or flip the card and rate yourself. A word you miss comes back later in the same run, and stays in your weak words until you get it right three times in a row.
tips[0].title: Learn the noun with its verb
tips[0].text: In formal German many nouns only sound right with one verb: eine Entscheidung treffen, Maßnahmen ergreifen, Kritik üben. When a card is a noun, think of the verb it goes with.
tips[0].check.why: Maßnahmen goes with ergreifen (or treffen) in formal German. machen and nehmen don't combine with it.
tips[1].title: Research words in their order
tips[1].text: die Hypothese → die Durchführung → die Auswertung → die Erkenntnis → die Schlussfolgerung: learning the nouns in the order a study runs makes them easier to recall.
tips[1].check.why: First you plan (Hypothese), then collect (Durchführung), then analyse (Auswertung).
tips[2].title: belegen and widerlegen are opposites
tips[2].text: belegen shows that something is true; widerlegen shows that it is false. nachweisen proves; sich stützen auf means to rely on a source.
tips[2].check.why: widerlegen = to disprove; belegen = to support with evidence.
remember[0]: Never say a noun without its article, not even in your head.
remember[1]: Miss a word? It comes back in the same run. Three correct answers in a row take it off the weak list.
remember[2]: Verbs and adjectives have no article: type them as they stand, like "widerlegen".
hook: Learn the language of research and formal writing with articles, plurals and the verbs each noun goes with.
